question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?
choices: Turn on the tap with the right hand to wash the dishes.
Turning on the tap using my left hand while holding the saucepan in my right hand.
After touching the rubbish bin and the pile of rubbish, turn on the tap using the right hand.
Using my left hand to turn on the tap while using my right hand to place the kettle under the running tap.
Turn on the tap by opening the lever.
correct_answer: Turn on the tap with the right hand to wash the dishes.
